paite: Koute zaw Khrist nasemte leh Pathian thuguk kemte bang in min hon thei uhen.
heading: Khrist Sawltakte Mohpuakna

paite: Hiai ah kempa mimuanhuai hih akiphamoh ahi.
Himahleh nou na hon ettelna uh leh mihing ngaihtuahna a na hon ettelna uh kei a ding in thil neuchik ahi.
Keimah leng ka ki-entel ngei tuan kei. Bangmah kimohsakna ding ka kithei kei a; himahleh huai in siam hon tangsak tuan kei hi; hon entelpa Toupa ahi zaw hi.

Huchi in ahun ma in bangmah thukhenna bawl kei un, Toupa hong pai masiah, ama'n mial a thil selgukte vak ah hon lakhe ding a; lungtang a tupte leng ahihlang lai ding hi; huai hun chiang in michih in Pathian a kipan in amau tan hun chiat in phatna aloh chiat ding uhi.

Unaute aw, na phattuampihna ding un hiai thu Apollos leh kei tung ah ka belh hi, huchi a koute a kipan a hindan na sintheihna ding uleh, akigelhsa pen sang a na lak ua kuamah mi khat midang sang a ngaina zaw a na kisaktheihpih louhna ding un.
Kua'n ahia nou a thiltuam deuh om a mu? Na muhsawn louh ngal uh bang ahia na neih uh? Huchi a amusawn lel na hih uleh na muhsawn uh athawn a piak hilou bang a bangziak a kisathei zenzen?
Tu in na vahta ua! Tu in na hong hauta ua! Kou lou in vai na hawmta uh! Ahi, vaihawm taktak le uchin, huchi a noute toh vai ka hawm sam theihna ding un.
Pathian in kou sawltakte, si ding a sehsa bang in ananungpen in hon sepkhia hi in ka thei ahi; khovelte leh angelte leh mihingte mitmuh a etnop a bawl in ka om uhi.
Kou zaw Khrist ziak in mihai ka hi ua, nou bel Khrist ah mipil na hi zaw uhi; kou zaw ka hat kei ua, nou bel na hat uhi; nou zaw mi pahtawi in na om ua, kou zaw mi simmoh in ka om zaw uhi.
Tutan in leng ka gilkial un ka dangtak ua, puansilh ka kiching kei ua, mi khut thak nuhna ka hi ua, mun leh mual ka nei kei uh;
koumau khut a sem in ka gim mahmah ua; mi'n hon tai uleh ka vualzawl ua; ahon sawi uleh ka thuak teitei uhi.
Mi'n hon gensiat uleh ka khem ua; tutan in leng khovel ninnok thil tengteng nin kihhuai bang in ahon bawl uhi.
Na zumna ding un hiai thu ka gelh ahi kei a, ka ta deihtakte bang a hon taihilh ding in ka gelh ahi zaw hi.
heading: Pa Bang A Thuhilhna Leh Vauna

paite: Khrist ah heutu singkhat nei mah le uchin, pa zaw tampi na nei tuan kei uhi. Ke'n Khrist Jesu ah tanchinhoih in noute ka hon neikhia hi.
Huaiziak in ka omdan zui ding in ka hon ngen ahi.
Hiai ziak in Timothi, Toupa a ka ta deihtak leh muanhuai, na kiang uah ka hon sawl hi. Ama'n Khrist a ka omdan, gam chih a saptuamte teng thu ka hilh zeldan noute ahon theisak nawn ding hi.
Huan kei na kiang ua hong nawn lou ding bang zen in khenkhat na na ki-uangsak uhi.
Himahleh Toupa'n pha asakleh sawt louchik nung in na kiang uah ka hong ding, huchi in miki-uangsakte kamhat thu hilou in, athilhihtheihna uh ka thei zawta ding hi.
Pathian lalgam zaw kamhat thu ah a-om kei a, thilhihtheihna ah a-om zaw hi.
Bang na deihzaw ua? Chiangpum toh hia, itna leh kingaihniamna lungsim toh na kiang ua ka hong ding?
